stem: What is one difference between the types of animal behavior described in the two selections?

options.label: A
options.text: Many animals use snakeskin for protection, but only octopuses are known to use shells to protect themselves.

options.label: B
options.text: Squirrels have several ways of protecting themselves, but octopuses have only one way.

options.label: C
options.text: Scientists understand why squirrels use snakeskin, but research is needed to understand why octopuses use coconut shells.

options.label: D
options.text: Squirrels disguise themselves with scent, but octopuses hide from the view of their enemies.
